name: viggle
description: Animate a character from a photo with an official Viggle motion or your own motion video.

interface.longDescription:
Viggle turns a character into a moving video. Give it a photo, illustration or avatar and a motion, either a short video of someone moving or one of Viggle's official motion templates, and it produces a Mix: your character performing that motion.

What you can do:
- Browse and search the official Viggle motion library by tag.
- Animate a character with an official motion or with your own motion video.
- Keep the original background or swap in a green or white one.
- Follow a Mix while it renders and pick it up again later.
- Check your credits and list your recent Mixes.

Sign in with your Viggle account; no API key is needed. It does not make text-only videos, edit existing videos, buy credits or delete content.
defaultPrompt: Animate this character with this motion video.
Make this image perform a Viggle motion.
Show me some Viggle dance motions.

positive.prompt: Show me some popular Viggle dance motions I could use.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists official motion templates from a dance or popular tag with titles, durations and preview links. No credits are charged.

positive.description: Animate an uploaded character with an official motion
positive.prompt: Animate the character in the attached image with the first dance motion you found. Use a green background.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares a draft, uploads the attached image, creates one Mix with the chosen official motion and a green background, and reports progress until the Mix is ready with a video link, or returns a resumable checkpoint while it is still rendering.

positive.description: Animate a character with the user's own motion video
positive.prompt: Make the person in the attached photo do the moves from the attached video.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads both files, creates one Mix that drives the photo's character with the video's motion, and reports the result or a resumable checkpoint.

positive.prompt: How many Viggle credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected account's current credit balance and does not start any generation.

positive.prompt: What happened to the last Viggle video I made? Show it to me if it's done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent Mix for the connected account and reports its status; if it is ready, returns its video link.

negative.description: Text-only video request without a character or motion
negative.prompt: Make a cinematic video of a sunset over the ocean.
Delete all of my Viggle videos.
Buy 500 more Viggle credits with my saved card.

publication.release_notes: First public release: create, follow and recover Viggle Mix videos from an image and an official motion or your own motion video.
